root_cause: The prior isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME hid the existing Keychain provider metadata. An isolated copy of non-secret lookup metadata allowed Muse to use the existing login without printing or copying a key.

scenarios.name: Acquire and verify the home lock from a shell tool executed by real Muse
scenarios.details: fm-harness.sh resolved muse; fm-lock.sh acquired scratch FM_HOME lock at PID 47682, equal to live Muse pane PID. Live amuse and musescore were rejected.

scenarios.name: Run and interrupt an authenticated Meta multi-step tool loop within one Muse run bracket
scenarios.details: muse-wonder-1.0 completed five tool batches in exactly one started/completed bracket. A new 20-file loop executed two tool batches and created two files, classified busy, received Escape, and closed its one started bracket with cancelled after tool result reconciliation. Classifier then returned settled.

cleanup: Private tmux server stopped, scratch homes and generated data removed, original auth.json unchanged.
